reported_template: In SPM12, we used the unified segmentation procedure with the TPM.nii file, which implicitly normalizes the functional space images to the MNI space of the TPM.nii immages.

In SPM, spatial normalisation is no longer based on minimizing the mean squared difference between a template and a warped version of the image. Instead, it is now done via segmentation. The tissue probability maps used for the segmentation are provided by the MNI  as part of the ICBM, NIH P-20 project, and derived from scans of 152 young healthy subjects. (source: SPM12 manual chapt5 p4)
